fixtures.name: main
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT
        (i - 2000)::INTEGER AS id,
        (CASE WHEN i % 11 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (i - 2000) * 1.5 END)::DOUBLE AS amt,
        CAST(i AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS price,
        (CASE WHEN i % 13 = 0 THEN '' ELSE 'n' || i END) AS name,
        (CASE WHEN i % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'v' || i END) AS nname,
        (DATE '2020-01-01' + i::INTEGER) AS d,
        (CASE WHEN i % 5 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (i % 3 = 0) END) AS flag,
        (CASE WHEN i % 17 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01' + to_milliseconds(i) END)::TIMESTAMP_MS AS ts
      FROM range(1, 4000) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 500)

fixtures.name: sum_offset
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT (i // 2048)::INTEGER AS c, (i % 5)::INTEGER AS g, (CASE WHEN i % 9 = 0 OR i % 5 = 4 AND i >= 2048 THEN NULL ELSE i - 2000 END)::INTEGER AS n, (i * 3)::BIGINT AS big FROM range(0, 4000) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 500)

fixtures.name: huge
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT (i % 7)::INTEGER AS g, ((1::BIGINT << 60) + i * 1000003)::BIGINT AS v, (i % 1000)::INTEGER AS w FROM range(0, 60000) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 2048)

fixtures.name: big
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT i::BIGINT AS id, (i % 97)::INTEGER AS g, CAST(i * 0.01 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS price, 'n' || (i % 1000) AS name, (CASE WHEN i % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE i * 0.5 END)::DOUBLE AS amt, CAST(i * 1000000007.01 AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS wide, CASE WHEN i % 5 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE repeat('x', i % 300) END AS pad FROM range(0, 50000) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 100000)
